$comment: Project settings, committed on purpose. CLAUDE.md §14.4 asked the user to throw
these switches; they belong in the repo where every session gets them, not in one
The SessionStart hook exists because the QA gate's install step is the single most
common reason a session skips the gate and reports from a cheaper check instead.
playwright-core lives in verify/, never in the root package.json (§9).

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm install --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; npm --prefix verify install --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; echo 'deps ready: root + verify (QA gate can run)'
